name: phi-spaces-mmo
description: MMORPG engine on phi-spaces: the world is one space; text first, a PixiJS tile map on top (first world: Leuchtfeuer)

scripts.docker:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm --build mmo-test
scripts.docker:prod:up: echo 'one host runs one profile: docker:nano:up on nano, docker:big:up on big, docker:local:up for both on this machine' && exit 1
scripts.docker:prod:down: echo 'use docker:nano:down on nano, docker:big:down on big, docker:local:down locally' && exit 1
scripts.docker:prod:logs: echo 'use docker:nano:logs on nano, docker:big:logs on big, docker:local:logs locally' && exit 1
scripts.docker:image: docker build --network host -f docker/Dockerfile --target production -t phi-spaces-mmo:prod ..
scripts.docker:nano:up: npm run docker:image && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile nano up -d --no-build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:big:up: npm run docker:image && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big up -d --no-build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:big:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big down
scripts.docker:big:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.hostnet.yml --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:local:up: NANO_CPUS=${NANO_CPUS:-2} PORT=${PORT:-3910} SPACES_MMO_SPACE_BIND=127.0.0.1 SPACES_MMO_ACCOUNTS_PORT=3961 SPACES_MMO_WEST_PORT=3960 SPACES_MMO_NORD_PORT=3962 SPACES_MMO_OST_PORT=3963 SPACES_MMO_SUED_PORT=3964 SPACES_MMO_SPACE=tcp:space-west:3950 SPACES_MMO_ACCOUNTS=tcp:space:3951 SPACES_MMO_WEB_REGIONS=west=tcp:space-west:3950,nord=tcp:space-nord:3950,ost=tcp:space-ost:3950,sued=tcp:space-sued:3950 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-local --profile nano --profile big up -d --no-build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:local:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-local --profile nano --profile big down
scripts.docker:local:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-local --profile nano --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:image:rust: npm run docker:image && docker build --network host -f docker/Dockerfile --target production-rust -t phi-spaces-mmo:rust ..
scripts.docker:rust:up: NANO_CPUS=${NANO_CPUS:-2} PORT=${PORT:-3910} SPACES_MMO_SPACE_BIND=127.0.0.1 SPACES_MMO_ACCOUNTS_PORT=3961 SPACES_MMO_WEST_PORT=3960 SPACES_MMO_NORD_PORT=3962 SPACES_MMO_OST_PORT=3963 SPACES_MMO_SUED_PORT=3964 SPACES_MMO_SPACE=tcp:space-west:3950 SPACES_MMO_ACCOUNTS=tcp:space:3951 SPACES_MMO_WEB_REGIONS=west=tcp:space-west:3950,nord=tcp:space-nord:3950,ost=tcp:space-ost:3950,sued=tcp:space-sued:3950 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-rust --profile nano --profile big up -d --no-build --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:rust:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-rust --profile nano --profile big down
scripts.docker:rust:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-mmo-rust --profile nano --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:dev:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev up -d --build mmo-dev
scripts.docker:dev:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile dev logs -f mmo-dev
